improvements: When a clock is set up for you before it ships, the registration screen now greets you by name and fills in your details, so you confirm them rather than typing them.
fixes: The registration screen's guidance no longer covers the email box or the Register and Skip buttons it is asking you to tap.
Guidance now steps out of the way while the on-screen keyboard is up, and comes back when you close it.
Wi-Fi now works on both panel revisions without a hand-set option: the clock works out which one it has on its own.
A clock that could not reach Wi-Fi on its first try no longer has to be unplugged and plugged back in to recover.
